source_checks.claim: Reported USZ model acceptors are exon 2 and nucleotide correspondence remains unresolved.
source_checks.evidence: Primary-paper indexed Figure 4/methods text and existing source evidence support reported EWSR1 exon 13/NR4A3 exon 2 and TAF15 exon 6/NR4A3 exon 2 labels. These are not a sequenced boundary supplied to this study. Direct PMC open returned a CAPTCHA; indexed primary text and the existing source evidence were used.
source_checks.assessment: Current manuscript correctly preserves the unresolved distinction and requires nucleotide sequencing before ordering.

source_checks.claim: Engineered E-N and T-N* constructs correspond to reported exon spans for the named reference-derived designs.
source_checks.evidence: Primary methods identify EWSR1 exons 1-12 to NR4A3 exons 3-8 and TAF15 exons 1-6 to NR4A3 exons 3-8; cryptic intron-2 T-N is separately described.
source_checks.assessment: Supports reference exon-span mapping. The manuscript also requires breakpoint confirmation for test articles and does not claim patient-derived nucleotide validation.

source_checks.claim: Six-base DNA gap is a cited minimum and seven-to-ten is the working range, while ten-base duplex screening is adopted.
source_checks.evidence: Cited review distinguishes six-DNA-gap RNase-H activity, seven-base complete activity and seven-to-ten optimal gap size.
source_checks.assessment: Consistent with the stated design rationale; does not establish a ten-base-pair cleavage threshold, which the manuscript expressly disclaims.

source_checks.claim: Only the computational portion of framework step one is performed and the proposed selectivity measurement relates to step three.
source_checks.evidence: Framework lists computational and experimental off-target identification in step one and experimental verification/margin assessment in step three.
source_checks.assessment: Scope is accurately bounded; ratio threshold five is explicitly an adopted convention.

source_checks.claim: FUS::NR4A3 was reported in two of five variant cases.
source_checks.evidence: Primary abstract reports two FUS::NR4A3 fusions among five variant cases. Bibliographic record is a 2026 Histopathology article, not a preprint.
source_checks.assessment: Supports the precise claim without implying exon-resolved evidence for all eight modelled FUS junctions.

reasoning: The paper distinguishes reported junction labels, reference-model sequence construction, engineered constructs and unresolved patient-derived cell-model nucleotides. It describes a computational application, bounds novelty to retrieved literature, and does not convert its prior public version or archive into external validation. Ten-base full-gap pairing is explicitly a convention; unmodified DNA:RNA model differences are expressly not validated bounds for LNA/phosphorothioate chemistry. No demonstrated citation/scope defect in this bounded review rises to blocker or P1.
limitations: Not a comprehensive independent verification of every cited article or literature absence.
No visual PDF/DOCX layout QA or public archive identity verification.
